# crosswork_srte_sid_lists (Resource)

This resource can manage an SR-TE SID list.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "crosswork_srte_sid_lists" "example" {
  name = "cwtest-sid-list"
  sids = [
    {
      index = 1
      label = 16001
    }
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) SID list name. Letters, digits, `.`, `_` and `-`; a space or a slash is refused.
- `sids` (Attributes List) Segments of the list in the order of the path. At least one. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--sids))

### Optional

- `instance` (String) Select an instance of the provider configuration by its name. Leave it unset to use the default instance.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The id of the object

<a id="nestedatt--sids"></a>
### Nested Schema for `sids`

Required:

- `index` (Number) Position of the segment in the list
  - Range: `1`-`4294967295`

Optional:

- `address` (String) IPv4 address of the segment. Set the label or the address of an entry, not both.
- `label` (Number) MPLS label of the segment. Set the label or the address of an entry, not both.
  - Range: `0`-`1048575`

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import crosswork_srte_sid_lists.example "<name>"
```
